<a id="page-design-systems"></a>
# Design systems

A design system's components and words, and words defined in the text (`define`). Open it when a session gives
you a design system, or an answer needs a word the notation does not have.

<a id="design-systems-a-design-system"></a>
## A design system

A design system is a folder (its manifest, its components, DESIGN.md and PATTERNS.md); a site names it, and its
pages call its components by name, like any word ([components.md](components.md)). Its theme gives the named
colors and text styles (`color=primary`). Its manifest is JSON; see the JSON reference's
[design-systems.md](../design-systems.md).

<a id="design-systems-defined-words"></a>
## Defined words

`define` at the margin, and the word as a line would use it, each value its default; under it, indented, the lines
it stands for. Those lines read the word's strings and keys by name in braces; `...` on a line of its own is where
the lines written under a use go. A defined word is written out where it is used.

```notation expands
define Pill "text" tone="neutral"
  Row gap=4 pad=[8,2,8,2] radius=12 fill=#FFF3F4F6
    Text "{text}"
Column gap=8
  Pill "New"
  Pill "Old"
```

It reads as:

```notation
Column gap=8
  Row#pill1 gap=4 pad=[8,2,8,2] fill=#FFF3F4F6 radius=12
    Text "New"
  Row#pill2 gap=4 pad=[8,2,8,2] fill=#FFF3F4F6 radius=12
    Text "Old"
```



<a id="design-systems-examples"></a>
## Examples

The JSON reference's examples for this page, printed in the notation. A `{…}` at the end of a line is what the notation has no words for yet ([_tails.md](_tails.md)).

<a id="design-systems-example-design-systems-md-id-name"></a>
### design-systems.md: id, name

From [design-systems.md](../design-systems.md) (the block at line 14 of its template, pages/design-systems.md). It is a design system's manifest, not a page. It is written as JSON:

```json
{"id": "acme", "name": "Acme", "version": "1.0.0", "description": "Flat, hairline-bordered, dense.",
 "design": "DESIGN.md", "patterns": "PATTERNS.md",
 "theme": {"primary": "#FF2563EB", "onPrimary": "#FFFFFFFF", "surface": "#FFFFFFFF", "onSurface": "#FF111827",
   "colors": {"border": "#FFE5E7EB"}, "dark": {"surface": "#FF141414", "onSurface": "#FFFFFFFF", "colors": {"border": "#FF383838"}},
   "textStyles": {"body": {"fontSize": 13, "height": 1.5, "color": "onSurface"}},
   "spacing": {"2": 8, "3": 12, "4": 16}, "radii": {"control": 7, "panel": 8}, "sizes": {"compact": 28}},
 "components": ["components/Button.json", "components/Card.json"],
 "replaces": ["filledButton", "outlinedButton", "textButton"]}
```

<a id="design-systems-example-design-systems-md-schema-pages"></a>
### design-systems.md: schema, pages

From [design-systems.md](../design-systems.md) (the block at line 27 of its template, pages/design-systems.md). It is a site's manifest (`site.json`), not a page. It is written as JSON:

```json
{"schema": 3, "pages": ["home.json"], "designSystem": "../design_systems/acme",
 "theme": {"primary": "#FF7C3AED"}}
```
